versions.changelog:
golang-modernize 1.3.0

- Added explicit orchestration support with isolated worktree rewrites for full-codebase modernization, keeping the main working tree untouched until review.
- Clarified orchestration and agent parallelism, including support for multi-agent mode (ultracode) on Claude Code.
- Improved session handling in inline mode: now uses the environment's question tool to ask about unsolicited suggestions, and reliably suppresses further prompts if declined.
- Updated allowed tools and compatibility details; removed legacy skill card file.
- Documented safer identifier renames via the gopls-backed skill, and clarified how cross-file changes are applied safely.
- Added `paths` field for Go source targeting.

golang-modernize v1.2.2

- Major SKILL.md rewrite for clarity, conciseness, and better contextual trigger handling.
- Added a consent check for contextual (non-explicit) modernization triggers; do not interrupt if user declines.
- Updated linter explanation, version coverage, and migration tables for Go 1.21–1.26.
- Improved separation of explicit vs. contextual invocation workflows.
- Refined tables and examples in modernization and deprecated package guidance.

golang-modernize 1.1.4

- Updated workflow to check the latest Go version using the Go Version Changelogs section (not by live fetch) and improved upgrade suggestion guidance.
- Modernization workflow now instructs to run `go mod tidy` and test suite before updating dependencies, and to prompt for changelog review.
- Clarified Go Version Changelogs table instructions; for versions newer than 1.26, instructs to consult official release notes.
- Minor content and formatting improvements to modernization steps and guidance.
- Version bump to 1.1.4 in skill metadata.

golang-modernize v1.1.3

- Updated metadata version to 1.1.3.
- Added the AskUserQuestion tool to allowed tools for enhanced user interaction.
- Minor formatting improvements (markdownlint-disable, angle bracket link syntax) in SKILL.md.
- No changes to logic or workflow.

- Bumped version to 1.1.1.
- Added a new evals/evals.json file for evaluation purposes.
- Updated SKILL.md metadata to version 1.1.1 (no content or workflow changes observed).

golang-modernize v0.1.0

- Initial release of the golang-modernize skill for Go codebases.
- Proactively suggests and applies Go modernizations (Go 1.21–1.26), including language, standard library, idiomatic, and tooling improvements.
- Supports both inline (contextual, as-you-code) and full-scan (project/CI) modes.
- Guides migration away from deprecated packages and patterns; references Go release changelogs for each suggestion.
- Manages ignored suggestions via a `.modernize` file to avoid repeated notifications.
- Integrates with modern linter tools, sub-agent parallel scans, and provides CI tooling and modernization best practices.
